references.text: God declares Israel as his treasured people (עַם סְגֻלָּה) who are to keep his covenant, the same expression used in Deuteronomy 26:18
Israel is called a holy people and a treasured people (עַם סְגֻלָּה) chosen by the Lord, parallel to the idea of being God's special people
Israel is described as a holy people and a treasured people (עַם סְגֻלָּה) for the Lord, the same concept found in 26:18
The Lord will confirm Israel as his holy people if they keep his commands, linked to the promise of being his treasured people
The Lord has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel as his own possession (סְגֻלָּה), the same theological theme of God's chosen people
Christ gave himself to cleanse a people for his own possession (λαὸν περιούσιον), fulfilling the Old Testament promise of the treasured people
Believers are called a chosen people, a people God has acquired for himself (λαὸς εἰς περιποίησιν), fulfilling the promise of the treasured people
